goal: Technical SEO review: titles, canonical links, structured data, status codes and crawl rules.
use: Technical SEO review: titles, canonical links, structured data, status codes and crawl rules. Use when a public page is added or its routes change.

steps.note: List the public pages and their titles and descriptions.
Check canonicals. Each page should name one address.
Check status codes. Removed pages should return a proper code, not a soft error.
Check crawl rules. The robots file must not block pages that should be found.
Report. Each page with its problem and the fix.
